spans.s:
1. ईर्म॑ or ईर्मा॑, ind. in this place, here, to this place;
 going constantly, or instigating [Sāy.], RV.
2. ईर्म॑ अस्, m. the arm, the fore-quarter of an animal, AV. x, 10, 21; ŚBr.; TāṇḍyaBr.
(अम्), n. a sore or wound, TāṇḍyaBr. iv, 2, 10 [Sāy.]

etym.s: fr. ईर्म = ईरित with अन्त, Sāy.

spans.s: (perhaps) having the biggest (or quickest?) horses on both sides of the team
N. of a team of horses or of the horses of the sun's car, RV. i, 163, 10.
